# git: config: disable core.quotepath

Show non-ASCII file names as they are in git output. **Motivation:** "better dx" — with the default `core.quotePath`, a file named `заметка.md` appears as `"\320\267\320\260..."` in `git status`/`git diff`; `git config --global core.quotepath off` prints the UTF-8 name.
